constraint: Perform an honest visual-preservation ImageGen edit of rejected attempt-007; whole-canvas resampling or redrawing is allowed and no pixels are claimed immutable. Preserve its exact four complete adults as the same two friendly nonromantic greeting pairs, exactly four vertical bark-staff support posts in the same left-outer, left-inner, right-inner and right-outer lanes, one plain cream canopy, one restrained garland, stone courtyard, mountain setting, crop, palette and Wands rendering. Preserve complete natural anatomy, natural five-digit open hands and visible feet for all four adults. The earlier demand to expose every shaft pixel and all four ground endpoints is retired as an independently reviewed noncanonical remedial tactic; do not shrink or unnaturally compress the people merely to reveal endpoints. At 140×196 each of the four posts must retain its own countable top end or canopy attachment, independent x-position and at least 40 pixels of continuous visible vertical shaft. Keep both outer posts visible to their separate ground contacts. Each inner post may be naturally occluded by at most one adjacent required adult across one middle-or-lower segment, and its ground endpoint may remain hidden, but its top attachment and substantial upper shaft must remain distinct and it must continue toward the paving as a planted support. The canopy and garland must read as one coherent four-post structure in believable perspective; an inner knot may be partly hidden by cloth, but no inner post may look like an unrelated hanging rod. Occlusion must never erase, merge, split or duplicate a post identity. Add no fifth person, fifth staff, animal, tree, branch, text, crossbar, rail, frame, pole, rod, tool handle, wedding or bridal attire, veil, ceremonial arch or other elongated object beyond the required four staffs. Preserve exactly four countable people, four support-post identities and one coherent canopy at mobile size.
reason: Attempt-007 produced the strongest canonical Four of Wands scene and clearly showed four adults, two greeting pairs, four separated support-post identities and one coherent canopy, but it failed the frozen attempt-007 tactic requiring four fully exposed top-to-ground traces and four visible endpoints. Three independent reviews found that tactic nonessential to Four of Wands meaning and harmful to natural composition after repeated retries. The versioned canonical contract now preserves historical attempts 1–7 while replacing that tactic with mobile four-post identity, substantial shaft and coherent canopy requirements. Attempt-008 uses a007 as its sole source, permits honest whole-canvas resampling and preserves the accepted scene without post-hoc approval.
reviewer: Planck, Harvey and Halley (independent Four of Wands canonical-contract-v2, natural-occlusion, provenance and 140-pixel review)
